title: (RHBA-2022:1717) Update to Fuse on OpenShift 7.10 images
portal_summary: Update to Red Hat Fuse 7.10.2 release of 'Fuse on Openshift' images.
portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse on OpenShift 7.10 images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.9|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.10|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Fuse on OpenShift container images have been updated to address the
following security advisories: RHSA-2022:1491, RHSA-2022:1642 (see References)

Users of Fuse Karaf and Console container images are advised to upgrade to these updated images, which contain backported patches to correct these security issues, fix these bugs, and add these enhancements. Users of these images are also encouraged to rebuild all container images that depend on these images.

You can find images updated by this advisory in Red Hat Container Catalog (see
References).
